class.name: KimodoLatent
class.brief_description: A row-major [code skip-lint][1, 1, 4096][/code] F32 LLM2Vec embedding handed to [method KimodoPipeline.generate_from_embedding].
class.description: The kimodo denoiser accepts a precomputed LLM2Vec embedding directly through the C ABI ([code skip-lint]kimodo_generate_embedding[/code]), so a caller that produced the embedding through a separate encoder can drive the denoiser without loading kimodo's text runtime. The embedding must contain exactly 4096 float values.

method.name: get_values
method.description: Returns the count of F32 values in [member embedding]. A well-formed latent has [code]4096[/code]; anything else is refused by [method KimodoPipeline.generate_from_embedding].

members.member: The LLM2Vec latent, 4096 F32 values row-major.
